the development of a metric of the propensity of a purchasing population to engage in postpurchase online WOM and with the identification of its relationships with product-related variables that have been previously shown to be related with offline WOM.

the antecedent factors of offline and online word of mouth are very similar, and that the online word of mouth is a good indicator of a population’s propensity to engage in the offline word of mouth.
